qualification: These are RTX5090 hardware Chromium and synthetic CPU-throttled samples, not real phone or 2019 MacBook results. A 30 FPS cap is not a guaranteed floor. Before/after pressure samples cover single 30-second runs and can differ in combat phase because one simulation falls behind. Raw misses are retained. Geometry bytes exclude the rest of the browser and the derived CPU grids.

geometry.qualification: Exact static geometry data for all thirty unit types and both detail levels; does not include browser, texture, renderer or instance memory. Triangle count and dimensions unchanged.

cpuBefore.qualification: FORTRESS RTX5090 hardware Chromium; phone viewport/touch/DPR emulation with CDP CPU throttling 4x and WebGPU deliberately unavailable. This is functional/proxy evidence, not an iPhone or 2019 MacBook frame-rate result.
checks: balanced culling reduces close-view drawing while all 6000 troops, thirty types, metre anatomy and exact paused state remain
shared presets change framebuffer/cadence and restore full high drawing without mutating the saved battle
390px / DPR3 touch and fourfold CPU-throttle proxy boots low power; real CDP taps select and pan/pinch never issue orders
Move then a real touch destination changes only the selected Azure company
absent WebGPU falls back, paused samples are rejected, and 30s real combat exports actual pacing/counts under the synthetic fourfold CPU throttle
optional CPU stress records every requested soldier actually drawn and alive; raw pacing is retained even when it misses a performance target
main-menu graphics selection and explicit override persist across browser reload
